coordinates: mm, board seen from the top as on the drawing. x runs along the long edge from the microSD end; y runs from the near edge (mini HDMI, micro USB), which faces the lid hinge. z is height above the top surface of the PCB.

thickness.source: not on the drawing (top view only); 1.0 mm assumed, measure yours

corner_radius.source: drawing: corner arcs measured from vectors

holes.source: drawing: 3.5 from the edges, 58 x 23 spacing; 2.7 diameter measured from vectors

height_above.source: not on the drawing; GPIO header (if fitted) about 8.5 mm, the tallest part

depth_below.source: not on the drawing; header pins under the board estimated at 2 mm

ports.label: HDMI
ports.source: drawing: mini HDMI centre 12.4, outline from vectors. Height not on the drawing; 3.5 mm assumed

ports.label: USB
ports.source: drawing: micro USB centre 41.4, outline from vectors. Height not on the drawing; 3.0 mm assumed

ports.label: POWER
ports.source: drawing: micro USB centre 54, outline from vectors. Height not on the drawing; 3.0 mm assumed

ports.label: CAMERA
ports.source: drawing: camera connector at the board edge, outline from vectors. Height not on the drawing; 1.5 mm assumed. The opening is a slot for the ribbon

ports.label: microSD
ports.source: drawing: socket outline on top of the board from vectors, in the same place as the Zero W socket. The Zero W drawing shows the 11 mm card sticking out 2.29 mm; assumed the same here. Card height 1.5 mm assumed

notes: The far edge (GPIO header) has no ports, so the lid's tuck flap goes inside the far wall.
The wall height allows for a fitted GPIO header but not a HAT.
